leads.claim: Jaime Maussan presented alleged non-human remains to the Mexican Congress.
leads.why: The document explicitly identifies the presentation of physical biological remains, even though it notes they have been discredited.
leads.material_description: Small, desiccated humanoid figure with a large head and three-fingered hands.
leads.quote: scientists have discredited previous alleged alien corpses Maussan presented as evidence of alien life.

doc_verdict: The document mentions the presentation of alleged non-human remains but explicitly states that scientists have discredited these claims as mundane.
